ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
objective: To provide affordable pucca housing to eligible urban families under the vision of Housing for All
target_beneficiaries: Eligible EWS, LIG and MIG families living in urban areas who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India
maximum_government_assistance: Up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per unit

verticals.name: Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC)
verticals.purpose: Construction of a new pucca house on the beneficiary's available land

verticals.name: Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)
verticals.purpose: Affordable pucca houses constructed by public/private agencies for eligible beneficiaries

verticals.name: Affordable Rental Housing (ARH)
verticals.purpose: Affordable rental housing for eligible urban residents

verticals.name: Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)
verticals.purpose: Interest subsidy on eligible home loans for purchase, repurchase or construction of houses

income_limits.EWS: Up to Rs. 3 lakh per year
income_limits.LIG: Up to Rs. 6 lakh per year
income_limits.MIG: Up to Rs. 9 lakh per year

source: Official PMAY-U 2.0, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
